text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
――Hmm? What's with that movement?
Are ya cold...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Got it, hot springs, right! Onsen!
You wanna soak in a Japanese bath, eh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of the crowd, I spotted Tamamo Cross and
Oguri Cap talking to a foreigner using hand gestures――

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No good... Not gettin' through at all.
I can tell they're in trouble though.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They seem panicked.
Could they have urgent business somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wait, doesn't this person look kinda pale...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Grummmble*)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see! They must be hungry!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
――Yer totally off!
They're lookin' for the bathroom!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If we don't guide 'em quick, disaster's gonna strike...!
Hey you over there, lend us a hand!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Foreigner, come on!
Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The closest restroom from here is in the park!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Thanks for helpin' out! Thanks everyone!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
They dashed off with such a relieved look on their face!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure those were words of gratitude.
I'm glad we made it in time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still, even without understanding their language,
how did you realize they needed the restroom?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I didn't get it at first either, but that tummy sound
and their complexion tipped me off!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's totally different from the face my buddy makes
when her stomach's empty next to me all the time!
choice_data_list: Why go so far to help?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's totally different from the face my buddy makes
when her stomach's empty next to me all the time!
choice_data_list: Why go so far to help?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's, ya know! So they can put in a good word
to the chairwoman about how good a girl Tamamo is!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama is embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Oguri--!!
We had a deal not to say that out loud, didn't we~!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm? I don't recall making such a promise.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I mean the unspoken rule kind of deal!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah――
Helpin' folks out has nothin' to do with who they are.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if our words don't get through, connectin' with heart!
That's my pride!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah!
Man, it feels kinda ticklish havin' ya say it straight like that!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Tama is kind. She tells me all about Kansai gourmet
and restaurants with portions big enough to make you drop!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's all just food stuff!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Grummmble*)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That was your stomach growlin', Oguri.
...Now *that* is the sound of hunger!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Talking about it made me want to visit
those eat-till-you-drop joints again...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's grab some grub then!
Lunch after doin' a good deed is gonna taste amazin'~!
